questions.stem_text: Which of the following may file an amicus curiae brief?

options.A: A defendant who wants to know what witnesses the plaintiff plans to call.
options.B: Former presidents who wish to send instructions to the justices who they appointed.
options.C: A senator who wants to impeach a Supreme Court justice.
options.D: Companies that are not involved in a court case but wish to affect the outcome.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - Companies that are not involved in a court case but wish to affect the outcome.

questions.stem_text: Which principle was established by the Supreme Court's decision in Marbury v. Madison?
Which of the following statements best characterizes cooperative federalism?

options.A: The executive and legislative branches working on legislation together
options.B: The federal government granting power over a policy area to the states
options.C: Governments working with businesses to address an issue
options.D: State and federal governments working on the same issue

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - State and federal governments working on the same issue

questions.stem_text: Unlike in a closed primary election, in an open primary election

options.A: voters select the winner by caucus instead of by individual ballots
options.B: the election results are not binding
options.C: any registered voter may participate, regardless of party affiliation
options.D: voters may register to vote on the day of the election

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - any registered voter may participate, regardless of party affiliation
